<function name="PostEntityCopy" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<description>
Called after the duplicator finished copying the entity, after <page>ENTITY:PreEntityCopy</page>.

Use <page>ENTITY:OnEntityCopyTableFinish</page> to modify the dupe table for this entity.

See also <page>ENTITY:PostEntityPaste</page> for the restore hook.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
</function>
